searchText: Hey <@412614104222531604> , I think it would be really useful to add eleel (https://github.com/sigp/eleel) support to kurtosis ethereum package, so we could run more CL nodes locally without having to run the same number of ELs - has this been considered? (although there's a little task that needs to be done before this can happen https://github.com/sigp/eleel/issues/33) hmm are you thinking of this for peerDAS testing? Im not sure if I'm sold on doing this tbh. It really messes up the general 1:1 presumtion that we generally have Yes so we can run more CL nodes on a single machine for CL specific testing Can you please create an issue on ethereum package I'll think about how we could do this nicely also issue 33 will be a blocker for sure I would still run devnet without it by default. And only use it when I want to run more CL nodes for some scenarios thats def a pre-req for anything would you wanna run just more BN but 1 vc? or 1:many:many ? or 1:many:1? Hmm didn’t think about that. I think I’d still go with 1 CL: 1 VC so if things go wrong, it shows in Dora Yeah I think that’s fair. Eleel is def more useful for running tests on live networks where EL sync takes longer ``` It is suitable for monitoring and analytics but should not be used to run validators and will cause you to miss block proposals if you attempt this. ``` not worried about this? Oh yeah that’s a good point I forgot about this. It doesn’t have block production, will check with Michael if it’s on the roadmap lol We can still test eleel without block prod and without vcs if its purely for cl testing, you could also just set really low ram/cpu limits on the EL and its basically "not there"
